Package model

Class TableManager

java.lang.Object
model.TableManager
public class TableManager extends Object
Manages all table-related operations such as assigning orders to tables, removing orders, and retrieving table-specific information.

Acts as a facade over TableList and ensures that tables are created when needed and kept consistent with orders in the system.
